turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes. Who decided Owen gets a zero, and did anyone speak to him before it went into the gradebook?
Look, I'll own it if I messed up.
"If." You entered a zero before calling me, and Owen read it on his phone in the middle of class. Who decided, and was he heard first?
Walk me through exactly what I did wrong with Owen's case. Step by step.
You want me to lay out your mistakes for you? Your own policy is printed in my bag, Hale, and you can read it yourself. I'm still waiting to hear who decided and whether Owen was heard.
